svg.title: Wireframe 01c: Canvas block and port states
svg.desc: Reference sheet of block styles on the canvas: default, selected, keyboard focus, error and warning badges, Learn highlight, a branch with three route ports, port-less resource blocks, each drawn differently (a count badge on a pool, an on and off strip on a schedule, a striped edge on a failure), with reference lines that differ by pattern, icon and word (long dashes and staffs, dots and sets hours, dash-dot and breaks down), and the connecting state where valid input ports show a ring.
svg.text: Block and port states (light theme; dark theme uses the same shapes). Flow: capsule; work: rounded box; resource: tag
Learn highlight: ring and step tag
Branch: one output port per route
Resource blocks: tag shape, dashed outline, no ports. Lines differ by
pattern, icon and word; set in the side panel, never selected on the canvas
Connecting: valid input ports show a ring. arrivals.out is already
connected to till.in; dropping on queue_1.in replaces it and a notice
says: “arrivals.out now goes to queue_1.in (was till.in).”
Ports: 12 px circle, 24 x 24 px hit area. Filled = connected.
Connections: 2 px, arrow at the input; selected 3 px accent.
